recentItems.title: The Tupac Tapes With Angie Martinez | Official Trailer | Netflix
recentItems.description:
For three decades, multimedia powerhouse Angie Martinez has held onto a piece of hip-hop history: an unreleased Tupac Shakur interview she recorded just months before his death. Now, she’s finally sharing it with the world in The Tupac Tapes with Angie Martinez, a four-episode video podcast event. Joining her to reflect on Tupac’s life, legacy, and lasting impact are Matt Barnes, Big Boy, Bootleg Kev, Joe Budden, Charlamagne Tha God, DJ Hed, E.D.I. Mean, Erica Ford, Dream Hampton, Lil’ Cease, Monie Love, Ed Lover, Aiyisha T. Obafemi, Wallo, and RZA.
